αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἴσιμα: αἴσιμος — fitting, right, according to what is destined; neut. acc. pl., object of εἰδώς: ’what is fitting’
αἴσυλα: αἴσυλος — presumptuous, reckless, wicked (paired with look-alike αἴσιμος); neut. acc. pl., object of ῥέζοι: ’wicked things’
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βουλήν: βουλή — plan, counsel, decision; acc. sg.
βροτοῖσιν: βροτός — mortal, mortal man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg.
δύνασαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic δύνασαι/δύνῃ): ’you can, you are able’
δώμασι: δῶμα — house, home; neut. dat. pl.
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses and heroes
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
εἰδώς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing’
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’)
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’
εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took up (for herself)’
εὐνάζοντο: εὐνάζω — put to bed; mid./pass. lie down, bed oneself down; impf. 3 pl.: ’were lying down to rest’
εὐρέα: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα ’broad backs’ (ἐπ’ εὐρέα νῶτα θαλάσσης ’over the broad back of the sea’) · also masc. acc. sg., epic by-form of εὐρύν, agreeing with a masc. noun (θαλάσσης εὐρέα κόλπον ’the sea’s broad bosom’)
εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’wide’ (κλέος εὐρύ ’wide fame’)
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θέλγει: θέλγω — enchant, bewitch, beguile; pres. 3 sg.
θεάων: θεά — goddess; gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῶν)
θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θείω: τίθημι — put, place; aor. subj. 1 sg. (Attic θῶ)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
καθήμενος: κάθημαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
καλυψοῦς: Καλυψώ — Calypso, a nymph; fem. gen. sg.
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl.
καλῇ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. dat. sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’)
κλαῖε: κλαίω — weep, mourn; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκλαιε): ’wept’
κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. nom. sg.
κύμασιν: κῦμα — wave, billow; neut. dat. pl.
κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’)
λέγε: λέγω — gather, count, pick out (the Homeric sense, source of the later dominant sense ’say, tell’); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλεγε): ’was counting’
λακεδαίμονα: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the land in which Sparta lies; fem. acc. sg.
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’)
λεχέων: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. gen. pl.
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέγιστον: μέγας — great; superl. neut. nom. sg.: ’greatest’
μέμνηται: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of; perf. 3 sg. (pres. force), + gen.: ’remembers’
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεμάασιν: μέμαα — be eager, be intent on, strive (perf. w/ pres. force); 3 pl. μεμάασιν, movable-ν form of μεμάασι: ’they are eager’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’)
μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj., companion to μή
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῖρ: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῖρ’ = μοῖρα)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ
νέηται: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. subj. 3 sg.
νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted · also neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, used as a noun: ’unerring things, the truth’
νισόμενον: νίσομαι — go, return, journey; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’returning, on his way’
νύμφη: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; nom. sg.
νύμφης: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; fem. gen. sg.
νύμφῃ: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; dat. sg.
νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl., epic νῆες
νῶτα: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. pl. νῶτα, poetic image ’the broad back(s) of the sea’
ξείνια: ξείνιος (Attic ξένιος) — of or for a guest; τὰ ξείνια as noun, gifts and entertainment due to a guest; neut. nom./acc. pl.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴκαδε: οἶκος — house, home; + directional suffix -δε: ’homeward, to one’s home’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position)
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οἷσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; possessive adj., neut./masc. dat. pl. (ν-movable): ’his own’ (agreeing with δώμασιν) · also relative, masc./neut. dat. pl.: whom (λαῶν οἷσιν ἄνασσε), not the possessive
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (= Attic οὗ) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl.
πάρα: παρά — beside; πάρα (accent drawn back) stands for πάρεστι/πάρεισι ’is/are at hand, present’ · also prep. placed after its noun (anastrophe)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’)
πάσχων: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’suffering’
πέλονται: πέλομαι — be, become, prove to be; pres. 3 pl.
πέμποιεν: πέμπω — send, convey, escort; pres. opt. 3 pl., potential in a relative clause of characteristic: ’who might convey’
πέμψον: πέμπω — send, send on one’s way, escort; aor. imper. 2 sg.
πέμψουσιν: πέμπω — send, convey, escort; fut. 3 pl.: ’they will send’
πήματα: πῆμα — suffering, woe, calamity; neut. acc. pl.
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
παρέθηκε: παρατίθημι — set beside, serve; aor. 3 sg.
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα)
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’)
πνοιῇς: πνοιή — breath, blast; fem. dat. pl., Ionic η for Attic α (= Attic πνοαῖς)
ποσσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic double σ (= Attic ποσί)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
ποῖόν: ποῖος — what sort of, what kind of; neut. acc. sg., reproachful: ’what a...’
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προτέρω: πρότερος — before, further; neut. comp. adv. προτέρω: ’further in’
πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
πτερὰ: πτερόν — feather, wing; neut. acc. pl.
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
πόντου: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. gen. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πύλον: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; acc. sg.
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’)
σκηπτοῦχος: σκηπτοῦχος — sceptre-holding, sceptred; masc. nom. sg.
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic)
τέκνον: τέκνον — child; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form)
τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
ταλασίφρονος: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; gen. sg. (epithet of Odysseus, from τλῆναι ’endure’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέσαι: τελέω — accomplish, bring to pass, fulfill; aor. inf.: ’to bring to pass’
τετάνυστο: τανύω — stretch, lay out; plpf. pass. 3 sg. with impf. force: ’lay stretched, lay spread’
τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’
τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
τηλόθ: τηλόθι (elided τηλόθ’) — far off, at a distance; adverb of place, epic (-θι suffix ’place where’)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
τροίης: Τροία — Troy; gen. sg. (Ionic -ης for Attic -ας)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’)
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’)
φίλους: φίλος — dear, one’s own; substantival masc. acc. pl.: ’dear ones, kin’
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φύγεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔφυγε)
χαλεπός: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, severe; masc. nom. sg.
χρυσείῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
χρύσεια: χρύσεος — golden; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
ἀγανὸς: ἀγανός — gentle, mild; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαπητὸν: ἀγαπητός — beloved, cherished (esp. of an only child); masc. acc. sg.
ἀγαυοῦ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. gen. sg.
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀκουὴν: ἀκουή — hearing, news, tidings, report; fem. acc. sg.
ἀκτῆς: ἀκτή — grain, meal (a distinct epic word, homonym of ἀκτή ’shore’); gen. sg.
ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl.
ἀμβρόσια: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine, ambrosial; neut. nom. pl.
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv.
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’)
ἀπήμων: ἀπήμων — unharmed, safe; adj., masc./fem. nom. sg. (νόστος ἀπήμων ’a safe homecoming’)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπείρονα: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. (the same form serves both genders for this adjective): ἀπείρονα πόντον ’boundless sea’
ἀποτίσεται: ἀποτίνω — pay back, make pay, exact requital; fut. mid. 3 sg. ’will exact payment’, or perh. short-vowel aor. subj. (the form does not decide)
ἀπόπροθι: ἀπόπροθι — far off, at a distance; adv.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀτρυγέτοιο: ἀτρύγετος — unharvested, restless (of the sea; exact sense uncertain); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic -ου)
ἀτρύγετον: ἀτρύγετος — unharvested (epithet of the sea; sense disputed); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόντον
ἀφίκετο: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄνασσε: ἀνάσσω — be lord over, rule; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + gen.: ’was lord over’
ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
ἄνωγεν: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; 3 sg., ν-movable, used with past narrative force (+ inf.): ’commands, bade’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐδήσατο: δέω — bind; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’bound on (for herself)’ · also of a man: ’bound on (for himself)’ (Μενέλαος … ἐδήσατο καλὰ πέδιλα)
ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλθών: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form; agrees with τέκνον) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: οἶκον ἐμόν ’my house’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
ἐοῦσαν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic οὖσαν)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπήρετμοι: ἐπήρετμος — at the oar, seated ready to row; masc. nom. pl. · also of ships, ’fitted/equipped with oars’: νῆες ἐπήρετμοι ’oared ships’ (masc. nom. pl.)
ἐπελθὼν: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, come upon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having gone to’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἐυπλοκάμῳ: ἐϋπλόκαμος — fair-tressed, with fine hair; fem. dat. sg.
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + acc. · also + dat., with anastrophe (χερσὶ ἐφ’ ὕδωρ): ’over, upon (the hands)’
ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)
ἑρμείαν: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; acc. sg.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἑὴν: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-person reflexive possessive adj., fem. acc. sg. ἑήν, agreeing with εὐνήν: ’his own (lair)’
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη)
ἔμπεσε: ἐμπίπτω — fall into, fall upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’fell into’
ἔνδοθι: ἔνδοθι — within, inside; adv., with the locative suffix -θι
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with anastrophe, accent thrown back after its noun (δήμῳ ἔνι = ἐν δήμῳ)
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic -εσι)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be’ · also as a copula with a predicate, personal: ’let (no one) be (gentle, etc.)’ (μή τις … πρόφρων … ἔστω ’let no one be ready-minded’)
ἔτετμεν: τέτμον (defective aor., ‘find, come upon’) — find; aor. 3 sg.: ‘he had found’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, enclosure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠγαθέην: ἠγάθεος — very sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg. ἠγαθέην, agreeing with Πύλον (here treated as fem., as often in this formula)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came’
ἤπιος: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; masc. nom. sg.
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδέειν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰδεῖν)
ἰδοῦσα: ὁράω (εἶδον) — see; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’seeing’
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ἴκελος: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.: ’looking like (him)’
ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.; where the metre makes the ι long, that is the augment, which the spelling cannot show; with short ι, unaugmented
ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα) · also relative adverb of place, ’where’ (= Attic οὗ): τῶν ἐνὶ δήμῳ, ἵν’ οἴχεται ’among those of the land where he has gone’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.)
ὅσ: ὅσος — as much/many as; relative correlative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσ’ = ὅσα)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’)
ὑγρὴν: ὑγρός — wet, moist; fem. acc. sg. used substantively: ’the wet (sea)’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’)
ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl.
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν: ’in his own (mind)’
ῥέζοι: ῥέζω — do, act; also ’perform a sacrifice’; pres. opt. 3 sg.
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
